candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout. Traces and logs show the gateway's client call to order failing with 500, propagating to checkout 502s.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within order (db, payment, inventory) not established; only the failing hop is bounded.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout 502s are caused by the order service returning 500 on POST /v1/orders, confirmed by correlated traces and gateway client logs. The specific fault inside order is not yet established.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces showing the internal error cause (db, payment, inventory) behind the 500
Order service deployment/version facts to rule out a bad release
